title: Finite-type approximation of an already global quasi-coherent module
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], $U\subseteq X$ a quasi-compact open, and $\mathcal H$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, pqf-def-coherent]. Assume $\mathcal H|_U$ is of finite type [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. Then there exists a quasi-coherent finite-type $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal E$ and a monomorphism $j:\mathcal E\to\mathcal H$ such that $j|_U$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Induct over finite subsets t of the affine opens. The invariant is a global quasi-coherent module E, finite type on W = U union the opens of t, together with a monomorphism E to H whose restriction to U is an isomorphism. Initially take H and its identity. For an inserted affine V apply the affine enlargement theorem to E on W, then compose the two monomorphisms. Restricting an isomorphism on W to U preserves isomorphisms via overFunctorMap. The restrictions of the composite are isomorphisms by functoriality.

proof.text: For a finite affine cover, W is top. Descend the finite local generators of E.over top to E using the equivalence of iterated slice sites and the singleton top cover. This yields E.IsFiniteType with the same monomorphism and restriction isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteType_global_approximation
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) [H.IsQuasicoherent]
    [(H.over U).IsFiniteType] :
    ∃ (E : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)),
      E.IsQuasicoherent ∧ E.IsFiniteType ∧ ∃ (j : E ⟶ H),
        Mono j ∧ IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor
          (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).map j)
